objective: Verificar en solo lectura el estado persistido del canario de Sincronizacion Historica despues del reinicio de Emergent. Revisar padre 11949 e hijos 11950/11951 antes de decidir retry. No escribir datos ni tocar Produccion.

queries.name: historical_canary_parent_state
queries.sql: SELECT SyncControlID,SyncRunID,Status,IsDryRun,AttemptCount,MaxAttempts,PauseRequested,CancelRequested,WorkerJobID,DispatchCount,ErrorMessage,StartedAtUTC,FinishedAtUTC,UpdatedAtUTC FROM dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones WHERE SyncControlID=11949 AND RunKind='PARENT'

queries.name: historical_canary_children_state
queries.sql: SELECT SyncControlID,SyncRunID,Status,IsDryRun,CodigoSync,AttemptCount,MaxAttempts,NextRetryAtUTC,ErrorMessage,CheckpointJSON,StartedAtUTC,FinishedAtUTC,UpdatedAtUTC FROM dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones WHERE ParentSyncControlID=11949 AND RunKind='ATOMIC' ORDER BY SyncControlID
